title: Custom eggless cakes, ready before your school run — Riverstone opens at 6am
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. That's not a coincidence — it's why Marsden Park and Schofields parents can collect a custom eggless cake before the school run, not squeeze it into a lunch break.

Every cake here is 100% eggless. Not some cakes — every cake, every time. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, in buttercream, fondant, or ganache. Free parking removes the other half of the friction.

48 hours minimum. That's what fresh baking takes. Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
